description: Change the pricing analyst settings for your workspace: turn the brief on or off, choose weekly or nightly, choose whether a written brief may be paid from your Last Price balance, with a monthly cap, and schedule the commerce cycle (daily or weekly at 03:00 UTC), which only drafts price proposals for approval and never pushes a price. Only the fields sent change. Paying from the balance is never on unless you turn it on, and it needs a cap. Refused until the brief is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope (and commerce proposal draft scope for the cycle fields); from the dashboard, an owner or admin. The two balance fields are the owner's choice: the agent that owns the workspace, a credential with billing write scope, or the owner on the dashboard. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

balance_monthly_cap_usd.description: The most the balance may pay for briefs in one month, in US dollars, at most 100. null removes the cap (only while paying from the balance is off).

balance_opt_in.description: true lets a written brief be paid from your Last Price balance once the monthly allowance is spent. Needs balance_monthly_cap_usd, sent now or already saved.

cycle_cadence.description: daily, or weekly on Monday, both at 03:00 UTC.

cycle_enabled.description: true runs your commerce cycle on a schedule with execute false: it drafts price proposals and never pushes a price.

enabled.description: true writes your workspace a brief; false stops it.

name: set_analyst_settings
